An '''ST-series super tactical droid''' was in active service to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. In the [[Standard year|year]] [[19 BBY]], he served under [[Admiral]] [[Trench]] during the [[Battle of Anaxes]] as they attacked the Republic's vital shipyards on [[Anaxes]].

==Biography==
The [[ST-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid|super tactical droid]] served the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] under [[Admiral]] [[Trench]] during the [[Battle of Anaxes]]. During the course of the Separatist campaign, Trench had been using a Republic [[Rex's battle strategy algorithm|strategy algorithm]] to gain the upper hand, using the [[Techno Union]]'s test subject on [[Skako Minor]], a captured [[Advanced Recon Commando|ARC trooper]] "[[Echo]]."<ref name="A Distant Echo">{{TCW|A Distant Echo}}</ref>

The tactical droid was present alongside Trench aboard the Admiral's [[Providence-class Dreadnought|dreadnought]] ''[[Invulnerable]]'', commanding the Confederate forces from above. Late in the campaign, the tactical droid informed Trench that the assembly plant has come under attack, only for the [[Harch]] Admiral to smile and remark that he would once again use the Republic's arrogance and desperation to his advantage. Unknown to them, the ''Invulnerable'' had been infiltrated by [[Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker]], [[Captain]] [[Rex]], the newly-rescued Echo, and the [[Clone Force 99|Bad Batch]]. Still unaware of the [[Mission to Skako Minor (Clone Wars)|recent events]] that had transpired on Skako Minor, Admiral Trench ordered the tactical droid to contact Skako Minor for Echo's algorithm. By this time, Echo and Tech had already intercepted the ship's interface unit and were able to mask Echo's transmission as originating from Skako Minor, fooling Trench. The tactical droid relayed Echo's algorithm, advising the Admiral to mobilize all troops to the assembly plant, claiming that the Republic would send all their reinforcements there due to their faith in the Jedi. The Admiral gloated and ordered the tactical droid to deploy more reinforcements to the assembly plant to crush all Republic forces with one strike.<ref name="Unfinished Business" />

As Confederate reinforcements arrived and overwhelmed both [[General]]s [[Mace Windu]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'s forces, Echo then issued a pulse that shut down all of the Separatist droids. The tactical droid then informed the flabbergasted Trench that the source of the pulse originated onboard the dreadnought. Realizing that intruders were aboard his ship, Trench ordered the tactical droid to dispatch battle droids to locate them. The tactical droid then asked the Admiral on how they were to deal with their apparent defeat on Anaxes, Trench responded by switching to his own strategy, triggering the countdown on a bomb planted on the assembly plant's fusion reactor. Onboard, Echo interfaced with a computer to decipher the bomb's shutdown sequence, but the tactical droid was able to trace back the source of the pulse and jam the signal. Echo was electrocuted, rendering him unconscious before he could transmit the sequence to the Republic forces on Anaxes. Confident that his victory was assured, Trench ordered the tactical droid to send more troops to deal with the clone infiltrators and prepare landing craft for their next assault on Anaxes. As they were about to exit the command bridge, Trench and the tactical droid were shocked by the sudden arrival of Skywalker. The tactical droid prepared to fight, but Skywalker cut the droid down in seconds before killing Trench. They eventually destroyed the ''Invulnerable'' and the Battle of Anaxes ended in a Republic victory.<ref name="Unfinished Business" />

==Equipment==
The tactical droid had [[Color|green]]-painted [[armor]] with a red logo depicting Admiral Trench's likeness emblazoned on its chestplate.<ref name="Unfinished Business" />

==Behind the scenes==
The droid first appeared in "[[Unfinished Business (episode)|Unfinished Business]]," the fourth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Seven|seventh season]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', which debuted on [[Disney+]] on [[March 13]], [[2020]].<ref name="Unfinished Business" />
